about: Wall bench modelled as a generic product: epoxy-resin worktop on a 4-drawer unit and a sink cupboard (pair of doors) with knee space between, recessed plinth, service spine with twin sockets, gas turrets and a data outlet, glass reagent shelf on brackets, resin sink with gooseneck tap and wrist levers. Services enter through a shared box in the void under the spine. Each type has its own geometry (parts carry 'only' for their type); shared parts have none.
